newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool unchanged to just firmer.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool unchanged to just firmer.

text.p: Prices in the Bradford wool market were either unchanged or just higher in anticipation of future firmness.
Varieties of wool and views of the strength of demand for the different types decided where prices edged up.
Coarser crossbred wools were no better than steady around seasonal lows while finer merinos, in good demand for fashion apparel but in seasonally short supply, gradually advanced.
At the coarser end, carpet demand reflects a dull market in Europe and much of the UK with London house price rises of limited overall importance.
